description: Measure the realised information coefficient of every signal in the SEC broad research panel, against a permutation null, and decompose the Fundamental Law ceiling using the project's own measured breadth.

fundamental_law.reason: IR = IC * sqrt(BR) requires BR to be the number of genuinely independent bets per year. The project's measured 1.15 is the effective number of independent STRATEGIES, which is a different quantity. Multiplying a cross-sectional IC by a cross-strategy breadth conflates two things and would produce a meaningless number, so no IR is published here.
fundamental_law.what_would_be_needed: An effective-independent-bet count for the cross-section, estimated from the residual correlation structure of the names actually held. Not yet measured.

label: future_sector_relative_return

method.note: The panel label is already sector-relative and every feature is point-in-time by construction, so no additional lagging is applied.

permutation_null.scheme: labels shuffled within each decision date, preserving cross-sectional size and the feature vector

small_sample_warning: Fourteen quarterly decisions is a small sample for an IC t-statistic. Treat any single-feature result as indicative, not established.
